faq_heading: Burnaby condos under $600,000: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Burnaby condos sell for under $600,000?
faq.a: 264 of 1,656, or 16%. A further 902 sold in the next range up, $600,000 to $799,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a condo in Burnaby?
faq.a: $647,500 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $600,000 is below the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $540,000 and $768,250.

faq.q: Which Burnaby area has the lowest condo prices?
faq.a: Cariboo, at $440,900 across 19 sales at $546 a square foot, median year built 1981. The highest of the 10 lowest was South Slope at $621,000.

faq.q: How fast do Burnaby condos sell?
faq.a: 29 days at the median, closing at 97.0% of the last list price, with 7% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $600,000).

In Burnaby, 264 of the 1,656 condos (16%) sold under $600,000. The median was $647,500, with the middle half between $540,000 and $768,250. The busiest price range, $600,000 to $799,999, had 902 sales.

blocks.text: Buying a condo under $600,000 in Burnaby

In Cariboo the median condo sold for $440,900 across 19 sales, $159,100 under $600,000. Across Burnaby the median condo took 29 days to sell and closed at 97.0% of the last list price, with 7% of the 1,656 sales above list. Check the strata fee and depreciation report.
